proof_scope: Python standards coverage for the OpenAI FastAPI interview service: Pydantic contracts, pyproject, module docstrings, file-size ceiling, and no obvious forbidden backend/storage patterns.

claims.proves: best-practices-python can guard the OpenAI FastAPI service for pyproject packaging, module docstrings, bounded file size, Pydantic contracts, and no PostgreSQL dependency.
claims.does_not_prove: full semantic correctness, production security, or complete static analysis.

cases.name: openai-python-service-standards
command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/openai-interview && uv run --extra dev python scripts/check_python_standards.py && python3 - <<'PYCODE'
from pathlib import Path
text=Path('pyproject.toml').read_text().lower()
assert 'fastapi' in text and 'pydantic' in text and 'postgres' not in text and 'sqlalchemy' not in text
assert all(len(p.read_text().splitlines()) <= 800 for p in Path('src').rglob('*.py'))
print('OPENAI_PYTHON_STANDARDS_OK')
PYCODE

capability_claims.description: The OpenAI interview Python service satisfies core Python project standards relevant to a FastAPI skill-chain demo.
